synthesized in the form of large brilliant button (3–5 g) by arc-melting under Ar atmosphere from high purity Ti (99.9%), Nb (99.9%) and Sn (99.8%). The ingots were re-melted 6 times to ensure compositional homogeneity.
The arc-melted ingots were then injected into copper molds by suction casting.

The as-cast samples were subsequently wrapped in Ti foil, encapsulated in sealed quartz tube under Ar, and annealed at 1000 C for 5 h. Annealed samples were either slowly furnace cooled to room temperature or fast quenched in ice water.
